title: Pre-create the asset-stage stamp directory during clean VIXEN builds
body: On the first queued build at base 5d247093, vixen_stage_assets copied its files but failed at cmake -E touch because build/application/main/vixen_stage_assets did not exist. I added a make_directory command before touching the declared stamp. The helper should create its OUTPUT parent as part of its declared build step so clean builds need no manual directory setup.

title: Set the VIXEN CMake root in lane build commands
body: At base 5d247093, the queued configure  from the assigned checkout root failed because the CMakeLists.txt is nested under VIXEN/. Recovery was to rerun the queued configure from that subdirectory. The lane command example does not state this working directory; provide a canonical checkout-root command or wrapper.

title: Automate per-worktree FetchContent cache selection
body: The successful clean configure required the manual setting  from the lane rules so each isolated VIXEN worktree uses its own FetchContent cache. Add a canonical CMake preset or derive the cache path per worktree so lane commands do not need a task-specific environment variable.

title: Make the nested VIXEN CMake working directory explicit
body: At base 5d247093, the queued command cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_TESTS=ON from the assigned checkout root failed with exit 1 because CMakeLists.txt is nested under VIXEN/. Recovery reran the configure through the same queue from the VIXEN subdirectory. The lane example does not state that working directory; add a canonical checkout-root command or wrapper.

title: Provide a per-worktree FetchContent cache preset
body: The successful clean configure command used env VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=/home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/togglelatency/.tmp/fetch cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_TESTS=ON from VIXEN/. Lane instructions require this environment variable to isolate FetchContent caches by worktree. Add a preset or derive the cache path automatically so each lane does not need to supply a worktree-specific variable.

title: Classify VIXEN configure separately from compilation for queue memory admission
body: The configure-only command labelled run2-baseline-config with --resource build reserved the generic class maximum 16688 MB and waited behind 24288-29684 MB of other reservations despite about 30 GB available. Cancelled my waiting queue PID and ran the same cmake -S VIXEN -B VIXEN/build -DYEROKET_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release through the live queue as --resource light (label run2-baseline-config-only); configure completed in 7.3 seconds, within the existing build tree. Derive a configure-only resource/memory estimate from the command so lanes do not classify it manually.

title: Identify the non-root input when kernel CodegenTool witness reuse fails
body: The documented check-kernel-test-suite.sh --suite all --kernel-root /home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy/.claude-worktrees/togglelatency --undertow-root /home/liory/projects/undertow --agent togglelatency, with UT_TEST_LOCK_WRAPPER pointing at the live global queue, stored SG PASS but CG lookup returned NO KEY: the supplied tree root must be the git worktree root. Both supplied paths independently resolve as their git worktree roots. The helper recovered by running CG fresh: 2084 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed, but could not store the passing witness. Print the offending root and git top-level at tools/kernel-test-witness.py:136, and normalize/document the actual input root, so consumers can recover reuse without guessing. Evidence: kernel lane .tmp/kernel-test-suite/cg.log and store.log.

title: Disabled LOD enablement was checked inside every ESVO traversal iteration
body: Fresh Release baseline failed LODRayCastingTest.NoPerformanceRegressionWithoutLOD in the full RenderGraph/SVO run and isolated run (LOD 0.417573ms vs regular 0.191012ms). The existing isEnabled predicate was evaluated per iteration. Hoist that existing predicate once after the body traversal choice; retain the unchanged performance gate and strengthen exact disabled-LOD hit identity. Consolidate invariant traversal predicates at dispatch rather than requiring each lane to repair the handwritten loop.

title: Selector pattern resolution ignored its declared integer parameter type
body: The phase-1 program_up:2@30 latency capture dispatched layer-2-program-up through the earlier layer-{index}-up binding, extracting 2-program and silently reordering layer zero. Revision and pixels did not change. Use the existing registered FlowParamType::Int schema to reject partial or overflowing integer extractions before choosing a pattern. Consolidate typed literal selector validation with the AppFlow binding resolver; do not add ordering priorities or duplicated action tables.

title: Scripted windowed editor witnesses need isolated X11 input
body: The queued program-field capture succeeded after the typed binding repair but was contaminated by live X11 clicks that deleted layer 2 and created a layer at ticks 33, 48 and 51. Analysis refused to invent missing-frame latency. Earlier baseline logs have no live dispatch. Add a mixed-input rejection to the capture analyzer and provision a private Xvfb entirely under the lane .tmp directory using apt-get download and dpkg-deb extraction (initial Xvfb download exposed missing libunwind8 and libXfont2). The witness harness should provide an isolated display and required dependencies, with bounded process cleanup, while continuing to use the real Vulkan GPU.

title: Full native capture fixture needs a documented isolated shader-cache contract
body: The recovered full RenderGraph/SVO run (global queue label run2-recovered-rendergraph-svo, log 1791573551) timed out vixen_editor_capture_producer at 181.42 seconds during device cleanup after its 140-frame loop; nine dependent checks were not run. Retrying unchanged fixture/consumer checks through the live queue with VIXEN_CACHE_DIR=$PWD/.tmp/editor-fixture-recovery-cache passed all 11 checks (editor 76.53s, HUD 143.37s). No timeout was relaxed. Consolidate cache ownership and lifecycle/teardown timing into the supported fixture harness, and identify cache contents or GPU contention before blaming scene semantics.
